description: Find inks similar to one ink, given by name (for example "tsuki-yo" or "Sailor Yama-dori"). basis tells why they are similar: "on_record" for inks InkPalette lists as similar; "color" when none are on record, so these are inks of a close color. match is "closest" when the name was not found as typed, so ink is the closest name.

ink.description: Name of the ink, with or without the brand

limit.description: How many similar inks to return (default 6)

name: find_similar_inks
title: Find similar inks
